{"triples":[{"subject":"Parameter Estimation","predicate":"uses","object":"Gibbs sampling method","object_type":"Method","source_sentence":"For parameter estimation, we use the Gibbs sampling method."},{"subject":"Models","predicate":"uses","object":"sequence of entity triples","object_type":"Other","source_sentence":"Its input is a sequence of entity triples."},{"subject":"Document-level","predicate":"uses","object":"filtering","object_type":"Method","source_sentence":"Document boundary is only used in a post-processing step of filtering."},{"subject":"Parameter Estimation","predicate":"uses","object":"2,000 burn-in of overall 10,000 iterations","object_type":"Other","source_sentence":"In our implementation of Gibbs sampling, we use 2,000 burn-in of overall 10,000 iterations."},{"subject":"Parameter Estimation","predicate":"uses","object":"probability distributions","object_type":"Probability","source_sentence":"The purpose of burn-in is to assure that parameters converge to a stable state before estimating the probability distributions."},{"subject":"Parameter Estimation","predicate":"uses","object":"interval step of 100","object_type":"Other","source_sentence":"Moreover, an interval step of 100 is applied between consecutive samples in order to avoid too strong coherence."},{"subject":"tracking","predicate":"uses","object":"specific burn-in","object_type":"Other","source_sentence":"Particularly, for tracking changes in probabilities resulting from attribute relations, we ran in the first stage a specific burn-in with only heads and trigger relations."},{"subject":"Parameter Estimation","predicate":"uses","object":"second burn-in","object_type":"Other","source_sentence":"This stable state was then used as initialization for the second burn-in in which attributes, heads, and triggers were used together."}]}
